text:
maria (support): DeltaCorp reports ~2x p95 token latency on /v1/chat-stream since yesterday's 'optimize-config' rollout. They attached a sample request id delta-req-331 and say it's impacting their SLA.

 tom (sales): They are on enterprise, very upset. Need an ETA for a fix and whether we can roll back.

 anya (pm): Adding to intake. Quick Qs: which model/route/config did they hit? any errors in the trace?

 kevin (eng-runtime): Looking now. Customer route=chat-stream, model=gptx-3.5-8k-quant, rollout_tag=optimize-config-v3.2.1 per their trace.

 deploy-bot: Deployed optimize-config-v3.2.1 to production (us-east-1) at 2026-03-19T22:14:12Z

 leah (eng-platform): Pulling autoscaler and node logs for the timeframe. Will paste metrics shortly.

 maria (support): customer trace: https://redwood-internal/traces/delta-req-331 (they also sent a sample tokenized payload).

 kevin (eng-runtime): Correlating timestamps: p95 jump lines up with the deploy. Initial hypothesis: batching window change in v3.2.1 reduced aggregation, increasing header overhead and causing more single-request execution. Also seeing repeated 'nonfastkernel fallback' logs in runtime nodes.

 leah (eng-platform): Autoscaler shows a brief spike in pod restarts around the same time. A subset of nodes reported GPU OOM and restarted; some pods then landed on nodes without the optimized kernel and hit fallback path. Memory pressure + kernel fallback could explain higher latencies.

 anya (pm): Options: rollback the optimize-config change (safe, fast), ship a hotfix to revert batching override, or deeper RCA. Which is lowest risk and fastest?

 kevin (eng-runtime): Fastest/lowest risk: rollback to 3.2.0 defaults (re-enable previous batching window + disable the new quantized kernel path). I'll prepare a rollback.

 tom (sales): Customer asks for a firm ETA. Can we give them a time to resolution if we rollback?

 kevin (eng-runtime): ETA ~30-45m to rollback canary -> validate -> promote. Will post updates.

 maria (support): I'll tell DeltaCorp we'll update within 1h.

 kevin (eng-runtime): Rollback PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/commit/abcdef — kicking off canary rollback now.

 deploy-bot: Started rollback optimize-config-v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 (canary) at 2026-03-19T23:02:03Z

 leah (eng-platform): Canary metrics look promising: sample p95 dropped from ~2.6s down to ~1.1s on the representative stream traffic within 10m of rollback. No new restarts observed on canary nodes.

 deploy-bot: Promoted rollback to prod at 2026-03-19T23:18:45Z

 anya (pm): Creating backlog ticket /jira/RI-1248 "DeltaCorp p95 regression caused by optimize-config v3.2.1". Assigning eng-runtime + eng-platform for RCA and mitigation.

 kevin (eng-runtime): Preliminary root cause: v3.2.1 introduced a batching-window override + an experimental quantized kernel. Under certain seq-length distributions this increased GPU memory use; some pods hit OOM and restarted, which pushed traffic to nodes lacking the optimized kernel and into a single-threaded fallback path — that fallback increased p95 substantially. Also found gaps in pre-deploy mem/regression checks.

 anya (pm): Launch/closure criteria for the ticket: (1) Full RCA doc with reproducer, (2) Automated mem/regression check added to CI, (3) Config guard to block deployment if batching/quant changes lack perf sign-off, (4) Test rollout plan + canary steps documented.

 tom (sales): Please share ETA for RCA and fix schedule with the customer. They want an internal postmortem.

 kevin (eng-runtime): RCA + reproducer by EOD. Fix (config guard + unit/integration tests) targeted within 3 business days. Will escalate if we hit infra blockers.

 maria (support): Customer updated — they appreciate the rollback speed and will monitor. Pushed the /jira/RI-1248 link to them. :thumbsup:

 anya (pm): Thanks all. Follow-up actions in RI-1248. Assigning kevin + leah. Leaving thread open until RCA doc is attached.
